t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Red purple pink and brown bring up a specific coloured basket. Stick with the same category until the value has decreased, then switch to the different coloured ones to use the othered coloured basket

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 coloured gnomes and 2 coloured baskets. gnomes: Blue, yellow, green and orange OPEN a Orange basket. gnomes; Red, purple, pink and brown open a RED basket.Remember one set of these colours. i.e the colours for the RED basket.stick with one set (red basket) until the value of mushrooms descreases significantly. When this happens, try switching to the next basket (Orange basket). Good Luck :)
